Original review:
I've been to several clinics in Phuket and Siam clinic has been by far the best experience! I get masseter Botox to treat my TMJ and slim my jaw, and unfortunately many clinics don't know how to do it properly. They don't take care with the amount they inject, and often you are not getting the full amount you're paying for (if it's too cheap to be true, this is probably the case).

Siam clinic was super prompt in responding and sent me the price list, then scheduled a consultation with the doctor right away. Dr. Aim explained everything thoroughly and took time to calculate exactly how many units I needed in each spot, which I really appreciated! They also showed me the unopened bottle of Botox and filled the needle in front of me, so you can be sure that you're getting the product that you paid for. The whole process was very efficient and painless.

The clinic itself is beautiful, very clean and modern. Apple and the rest of the staff were so friendly and really took care of me, thank you ka 🙏💕 I also loved the attention to details, such as a welcome drink and cookies, and sending me home with a small vial of anti-bruising cream.

If you're looking for a professional clinic with good prices, you can't go wrong with Siam Clinic! They offer many services and I'm sure that you will leave satisfied, just like me ☺️
